## Purpose

Describe the problem and the observable outcome.

## Checks

- [ ] A test was added, or the absence of one is justified
- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm release:check`
- [ ] No secret, local path or personal data
- [ ] Permissions and confirmations preserved
- [ ] Migration and documentation updated if needed

## Provenance

NEXUS is written largely by AI agents under human review, so we ask every contribution the same
question. Answering honestly costs nothing and makes review faster.

- [ ] This contribution contains AI-generated code
- [ ] I have read every line I am submitting, and I take responsibility for it
- [ ] My commits carry `Signed-off-by:` (see [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin))

## Risks and rollback

State the external effects, the compatibility impact and how to roll back.
